lead: Four to two hundred people as small avatars with the name beneath. Only the portrait and the name are rendered — roles and biographies are ignored, because the point of a wall is the number of faces.
note: The note under the wall is for the sentence that belongs to the whole list: who was left out, who asked not to be named, where the full record lives.

people.title: so the last row keeps the rhythm
because the name is already there
A link wraps face and name together
